text: I'm really sorry to message so late, I'm a foster carer and I've only had this young man (11) for a few weeks so I don't know him well yet and maybe I'm being overcautious. He showed me some marks on his arm before bed and I couldn't really make them out on his skin, he's dark skinned, so I had a look at the paler bits. There are small dark spots on his palms and a few on the inside of his cheek when he opened his mouth. I put a glass against the ones on his hand and they stayed exactly the same, didn't go lighter at all. He says he hasn't banged himself. I'm sorry if this is nothing, I just didn't want to leave it.
